# ADR-3038: A04: Business-logic retry budget for workflow 2

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Unbounded retries amplify costly side effects.

## Decision

Workflow engines SHALL set a business-logic retry budget for workflow 2 (A04-2).

## Consequences

Idempotency keys accompany mutating steps.
